context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about blog hobbies
purpose: Teach: イイ/雑記/ブログランキング/オヤジ/幾ら/つづけ/有無/不快

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、メイのブログ、最近イイ感じだね。
lines.en: Hey, Mei, your blog's been looking pretty good lately.
lines.style: Warm casual opener with a soft compliment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう〜。ただの雑記なんだけど、つづけてたら読者が増えてきたの。
lines.en: Thanks! It's just a casual journal, but as I kept going, readers started coming.
lines.style: Bashful but pleased, slightly dreamy tone overall.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ブログランキングとか登録してるの？幾らくらい収益あるんだろ。
lines.en: Are you signed up for blog rankings? I wonder how much you actually earn.
lines.style: Curious leaning-in gossipy energy at the counter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 収益なんてないよ〜。でもうちのオヤジが急に応援してきて、ちょっとびっくりした。
lines.en: No earnings at all! But my dad suddenly started cheering me on, which surprised me.
lines.style: Laughing softly through an embarrassed family reveal.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、お父さんが？意外。でも応援の有無で結構気持ち変わるよね。
lines.en: Whoa, your dad? Unexpected. But whether you get support really changes how you feel.
lines.style: Genuine surprise turning into thoughtful agreement here.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんとそう。前は不快なコメントもあって、書くのやめようかと思ったの。
lines.en: Exactly. I used to get nasty comments and thought about quitting writing.
lines.style: Softer vulnerable confession shared quietly over coffee.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかる〜。でも続けてよかったじゃん。私もファンだよ。
lines.en: I get it. But aren't you glad you kept at it? I'm a fan, you know.
lines.style: Reassuring barista warmth with light playful teasing.
